lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spot clusters arranged in semi-linear vertical columns, with spot diameter increasing along the anterior-to-posterior axis behind the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal alignment of spot centroids, forming a distinctive grid-like geometry on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature positioned in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two elongated high-contrast objects (remoras) with distinct white trailing edges, positioned ventrally to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
